target: Hito del Paso del Dosel Alto.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Ladera pronunciada donde raíces gruesas sujetan el suelo; debe mostrar el cambio desde bosque cerrado hacia bosque de montaña.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape of Pendiente de las Raíces Altas. A steep ascending forest slope is held together by massive but natural exposed roots crossing damp soil and rock. The traveler route picks its way upward between them without built stairs. Lower Nhal remains dark and enclosed behind; higher up, trunks thin slightly and colder mountain light reaches exposed stone. The roots must visibly stabilize the slope rather than form fantasy architecture.
negative_constraints: No root staircase, carved steps or bridges
No glowing plants, spirits or runes
No broad open alpine view yet
No characters or creatures as focal subject
